title: Error Propagation & Significant Figures Rules
formulas: In multiplication and division the result keeps as many significant figures as the LEAST precise factor.
In addition and subtraction the result keeps as many decimal places as the LEAST precise term.
keyPoints: Round only at the end — rounding each intermediate step is the standard way to lose the last digit.
